name: Single-Leg Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Face a sturdy chair and hinge forward at your hips to brace both hands on its back.
Balance on one leg with your knee slightly unlocked and lift the other foot behind you.
Drive through the ball of your standing foot to raise your heel as high as you can, contracting your calf firmly at the top.
Lower your heel smoothly back down to the floor, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Keep the hinge steady as your heel rises so your torso does not rock.
Use a steady tempo without bending your standing knee to assist the lift.
